Definition: strictly a clipping, i.e. gold (as dug out)
BiblicalUsage: betser — gold ore — it shows up twice, in Job 22:24 and Job 22:25.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that betser shows how carefully God chose His words — nothing in Scripture is filler.
